principle: Fact != calculation != estimate != inference != opinion. Unknown values are not replaced with invented precision.

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue KRW372.534bn, operating income KRW176.997bn, net income KRW151.961bn and OCF KRW179.469bn.
evidence.source: KRX KIND FY2025 business report filed 2026-03-18

evidence.claim: FY2025 LEENO PIN sales KRW87.100bn, IC TEST SOCKET KRW243.944bn and medical-device parts KRW38.138bn; pin/socket products were about 88.9% of revenue.
H1 2026 revenue KRW242.959bn, operating income KRW120.814bn, net income KRW106.319bn and OCF KRW68.533bn. Q2 revenue was KRW143.187bn and Q2 operating margin about 51.3%.
June 2026 accounts receivable KRW101.645bn versus KRW52.853bn at FY2025 year-end; inventory KRW20.489bn versus KRW15.515bn. H1 cash flow includes an approximately KRW46.811bn receivable cash outflow.
June 2026 cash KRW86.772bn, current financial assets KRW340.042bn and non-current financial assets KRW21.483bn, totaling about KRW448.297bn; total liabilities were about KRW80.101bn.
H1 2026 PPE purchases were KRW41.366bn and intangible purchases KRW0.477bn, versus KRW32.933bn and KRW0.195bn in H1 2025.

The company states facility investment is internally funded. K-Water land consideration was about KRW75.481bn with KRW74.514bn paid; factory/equipment investment is planned at KRW97.182bn, with KRW50.384bn spent through FY2025, for capacity expansion and R&D. Construction period runs through 2026-11-10.
FY2025 major customers A/B/C generated KRW83.152bn, KRW61.539bn and KRW58.427bn respectively, about 54.5% of FY2025 revenue in aggregate.
H1 2026 major customers A/B/C generated KRW57.881bn, KRW47.566bn and KRW30.258bn, about 55.9% of H1 revenue; largest customer about 23.8%.
H1 2026 IC TEST SOCKET sales were about KRW166.4bn and LEENO PIN about KRW56.5bn, together about 91.7% of revenue; total exports were about KRW203.4bn, roughly 83.7% of revenue.
June 2026 issued shares were 76,211,850 with 316,250 treasury shares; no stock options have been granted.

Founder/CEO Lee Chae-yoon sold 7,000,000 shares at KRW90,000 via off-hours transaction on 2026-06-16; ownership fell from 34.66% to 25.48%. No major share-contract/pledge amount was reported in the June 12 large-holder filing.
FY2025 financial-statement audit and internal-accounting-control opinions were unqualified; no going-concern uncertainty was identified in reviewed material.
As of 2026-09-08 the labor union had been on full strike for 48 days; a near-final wage/collective-bargaining settlement failed at the last stage although pay terms had materially converged.
2026-09-10 reference market price KRW71,200, with the page showing previous close KRW70,100 and intraday range KRW68,300-72,000.
FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025 produces TTM revenue KRW424.560bn, operating income KRW209.429bn, net income KRW187.825bn and OCF KRW166.847bn.

TTM OCF minus disclosed PPE and intangible purchases equals KRW97.895bn. Subtracting approximately KRW9.365bn TTM interest receipts gives KRW88.530bn operating-cash diagnostic. It is not normalized owner FCF.

At a 10% required return, scenario values are approximately KRW21,265 Bear, KRW59,390 Base and KRW110,735 Bull per share. Current price implies approximately 11.92% annual revenue growth in years 2-10 under retained Base economics after 20% first-year growth.

High customization, qualification reliability and end-to-end in-house manufacturing create a meaningful switching-cost/process-knowhow moat, but customer retention and independent market share are not directly disclosed.
Business quality is high but current expectation gap and open factory-ROIC/customer-concentration/permanent-loss gates do not support buy authorization.
